actions.name: grow
actions.purpose: Grows the core of a mask by a disc, and further downward for a shadow.

arguments.name: px
arguments.purpose: The radius of the disc, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0 to 10000.

arguments.name: down_px
arguments.purpose: How many pixels further down the grown core reaches, from 0 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose core is grown.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the grown core, its blend cleared and its protect kept.

artifact_types.name: mask
artifact_types.purpose: What to change in an image (core), how the change fades (blend) and what to keep (protect), with the band profile and the prescriptions it carries.

artifact_types.name: location
artifact_types.purpose: Where something is in an image: a box, a polygon, a view, a line, a stroke, the whole image, or that it is absent.

artifact_types.name: image
artifact_types.purpose: A picture file held whole: a photograph, a composite or a crop; or a rendering of another artifact, which is never accepted in that artifact's place.

artifact_types.name: band_profile
artifact_types.purpose: A band along a line: its half-width for each row, with the line and the sampling windows it was measured through.

artifact_types.name: series
artifact_types.purpose: Values measured along the rows of an image, such as the width of a feather or the step of a tone ramp for each row.

artifact_types.name: plan
artifact_types.purpose: How a wrapped cut was taken from a panorama, and so how it goes back: the width of the strip taken from each side of the seam.
